public_health_question.v: How should monkeypox be prevented and treated in persons with HIV infection in the United States?

ev.q: CDC has developed clinical considerations for prevention and treatment of monkeypox in persons with HIV infection
Interim Guidance for Prevention and Treatment of Monkeypox in Persons with HIV Infection — United States, August 2022
including pre-exposure and postexposure prophylaxis with JYNNEOS vaccine, treatment with tecovirimat, and infection control.
